summary: Announces an upcoming move of the NIC's NLS service, related to RFCs 620 and 621.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 609 tells ROME, ARPA and NIC users that their services were planned to move from ARC/NIC to TYMSHARE's OFFICE-1 system. The transfer would wait until hardware problems were resolved, and the exact date would be announced later.

subtitle: Notice of a planned move of NIC and NLS services to OFFICE-1.

tldr.problem: The RFC announces a planned transfer of ROME, ARPA and NIC users' computer services from ARC/NIC to a system being installed at TYMSHARE.
tldr.mechanism: The new system, OFFICE-1, would receive users' directories and provide their NLS service after its hardware became reliable.
tldr.outcome: The exact move date had not yet been announced; users were asked to watch for a later notice.

today: RFC 609 is a notice of a planned transfer of NIC/NLS user services to OFFICE-1; it says the exact date would be announced later.

sections.title: Services Moving to OFFICE-1
sections.content: The RFC says that within the next few weeks, computer services for ROME, ARPA and NIC users would be transferred from the ARC/NIC system to OFFICE-1, a new system being installed at TYMSHARE in Cupertino, California. Once the hardware was reliable, the users' directories would be transferred and they would receive NLS service from OFFICE-1.
sections.plainLanguage: The Network Information Center planned to move several users' services and directories to a new computer called OFFICE-1. After the move, NLS service would come from that system.

sections.title: Hardware Readiness and Site Numbers
sections.content: At the time of the notice, the new system was experiencing hardware difficulties. The NIC and TYMSHARE staff were working to resolve them before transferring the users' directories. The RFC identifies OFFICE-1 as site 53 (octal) for Telnet and site 43 (decimal) when talking to a TIP.
sections.plainLanguage: The transfer depended on fixing hardware problems first. The RFC gives different site numbers for Telnet and TIP connections.

sections.title: The Date Was Still To Be Announced
sections.content: The RFC does not give an exact transfer date. It asks users to watch for upcoming announcements that would identify when their directories were to be moved to OFFICE-1.
sections.plainLanguage: Users did not yet have a move date. The note says a later announcement would provide it.
